name: FedoServerTools
author: Fedo
description: Mostly server-side: reports connected players (with biome/armor/SteamID) and the current season (if Seasons is installed) to the Fedoheim API every ~30s so the launcher can show server status, and forces 'Public position' on for everyone. Also posts session events (connect/disconnect/death/server start-stop/world saved) to a Discord webhook, and skips the main menu straight to character creation/auto-connect when the active profile has an auto-connect target configured. If distributed through a player modpack, ServerToken must stay blank in that shared .cfg -- fill it in only on the actual dedicated server, installed manually.
